title: Microwindow elastic batcher + KV priority slicing to stabilize mixed-length workloads
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Our continuous batcher shows high variance in slot occupancy and KV cache fragmentation when serving mixed prompt/response length workloads (short single-turn prompts and long multi-turn responses). This causes tail latency spikes and increased per-token cost under realistic production mixes. Proposal: implement a microwindow-based elastic batching layer that dynamically adjusts microwindow sizes per worker based on short-term length distribution gradients, and pair it with a KV priority-slicing policy that tiers entries (hot/warm/cold) and supports temporary pinning and time-decayed residency scores. Additionally add opportunistic GPU memory compaction triggers during low-utilization windows and a lightweight defragmentation hint to allocator to reduce slab fragmentation.
acceptance_criteria: Canary cluster (4xA100-80GB) shows no p99 latency regression >5% compared to baseline under canonical mixed-length mix
End-to-end token unit-cost reduced by >=8% in production-like trace replay
KV cache hit-rate increases >=8% and cold-eviction rate decreases without increasing tail latencies
New metrics (microwindow_size, tier_evictions, compaction_time_ms) are emitted and visible in Console dashboards
Feature behind a runtime feature flag and can be toggled per-customer and per-pool
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Spike implemented prototype in serving-scheduler branch. Microwindow controller accepts window_target_ms and adaptivity_beta.
2026-03-04: Local bench with synthetic mix (70% short <=32 tokens, 30% long >=512 tokens) shows 10% throughput improvement and 18% p99 reduction with microwindow=12ms baseline.

2026-03-06: KV priority slicing algorithm sketched: each entry has score = alpha*last_access_ts + beta*seq_residency + gamma*pin_count; bucket into hot/warm/cold with probabilistic eviction from cold first.
2026-03-08: Integrated KV preemption with batcher: when microwindow shrinks, warm->cold demotion occurs to free transient space; added counters for tier promotions/demotions.

2026-03-10: Run cluster replay on workload-capture-2026-02 (30M requests) on 4xA100. Observed KV hit-rate +9.4%, overall throughput +11%, p99 latency down 27% for short prompt class. Memory compaction added negligible overhead when scheduled in idle gaps (avg compaction_time_ms=48).
2026-03-12: Preparing canary config and rollout plan. Need approval for telemetry schema change and safety threshold values (min_window_ms=6, max_window_ms=80).
decisions: Use microwindow controller per GPU worker rather than global controller to better adapt to localized queue skew.
KV residency scoring uses decayed last_access_ts with exponential half-life 60s (configurable).
Compaction event limited to contiguous idle window >=100ms to avoid impacting steady-state throughput.
Expose three knobs via Console: adaptivity_beta, cold_eviction_rate_limit, compaction_idle_threshold_ms.
Feature gated behind 'elastic_microwindow_v1' feature flag and enabled only for Dedicated pools in initial canary.
Telemetry names: microwindow_size_ms, kv_tier_evictions{hot,warm,cold}, kv_pin_count, gpu_compaction_events, gpu_compaction_time_ms.
review_feedback: PM (A. Singh) 2026-03-05: Emphasize observability for debugging tail latencies; ask for automated regression tests comparing p50/p95/p99 against baseline traces.
Design (R. Park) 2026-03-07: Avoid changing API surface; ensure user-visible rollout is only via Console flags and API identity mapping.
SRE (J. Patel) 2026-03-09: Add circuit-breaker to disable compaction if compaction_time_ms > 200ms for 3 consecutive events; ensure alerting on sudden increase in cold_evictions.
Security (L. Wong) 2026-03-11: No new customer data persisted; telemetry is aggregated metrics only — ok but request opt-out for Private on-prem installs.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: GPU compaction can cause CPU/GPU stalls if triggered poorly. Mitigation: only run in idle windows >=100ms and provide circuit-breaker metrics to auto-disable.
Risk: New eviction logic may increase cold starts for rare long dialogues. Mitigation: keep a small pinned hot set for long-session ids and monitor cold_evictions per-customer.
Risk: Telemetry gaps when migrating schema. Mitigation: dual-write old and new metrics for one cycle and validate in dashboards before switching consumers.
Risk: Regression for low-throughput single-tenant pools. Mitigation: default to conservative min_window_ms and allow per-pool opt-out.
